environment: Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie) .NET; synthetic binary fixtures and real local TLS/WebSocket transport; no physical game or device

tests.name: Rally byte layout: speed/RPM/gear/pedals/G-force
Rally does not invent extended ACC or timing fields
Reverse and neutral wire convention
Short, NaN and impossible telemetry rejected
Statics UTF16 offsets and RPM limit
Stale fields retain original sample timestamp
First packet id zero, duplicates and game exit/restart
Key binding validation prevents system commands
Pairing, hashed persistence, wrong secret and revocation
Session replay and throttling; key-up exempt
Foreground, explicit arming and per-device permission
Two devices share modifier ownership; disconnect and focus watchdog
Repeat reports a failed first input honestly and stops on key-up
Read-only unsupported action and invalid phase never inject input
BeamNG OutGauge header, unit conversion and invalid packet
TLS pin, two WebSocket clients, control ack, disconnect/reconnect, stale and revoke
TLS pin rejection, revoked credentials, malformed messages and disconnect releases held input
Configuration validation and control is disarmed after restart
Car-specific maps, legacy import and empty overrides persist without cross-car leakage
Queued presses cancel on release; other actions and key-up remain responsive
DEMO is labeled, synthesizes fields and hard-blocks all real input
DEMO through real TLS: role permissions, profile change and never SendInput
